paragraphs.text: The Dobéhma are a human women-only race with lilac-colored hair from Dominaria .

According to myth, shortly after the fall of the Sarpadian Empires there lived a Neo- Ebonic priest-king named Vetro , who thought himself Tourach incarnate. His slave-wife killed him and their sons and fled with her daughters. She was cursed by Vetro from beyond the grave to always give birth to girls and to wander the world forever.
A notable Dobéhma is the planeswalker Vram .
